title: Choose YAFFW's grounded redesign
question: Keep the media-first workspace, re-roll its composition, or take the familiar editor fallback.

options.label: Media-First Workspace
options.lineage: contemporary desktop media utilities and direct-manipulation tools
options.thesis: The loaded video is the app; Selection is its single continuous control surface, and everything else appears only when needed.
options.viewport: A large edge-to-edge media field occupies the upper workspace, one uninterrupted Selection strip spans the bottom, and a single contextual drawer replaces permanent nested inspectors.
options.risk: Secondary audio and output state must remain discoverable without rebuilding the inspector stack in disguise.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark central viewer, inspector, transport bar, and stacked timeline executed with impeccable restraint.
canonCard.viewport: The conventional editor arrangement, simplified and polished around one active asset.
canonCard.risk: It returns to the category language and persistent panel structure the redesign is meant to escape.
